categories.title: 좀비 개체수
categories.description: 전체 개체수, 분포, 자연 재생성과 이동을 설정합니다.

categories.title: 시간 · 기후
categories.description: 하루 길이, 시작 시점, 낮과 밤, 날씨 주기를 설정합니다.

categories.title: 전기 · 수도 · 발전기
categories.description: 전기와 수도 중단, 경보기와 발전기 동작을 설정합니다.

categories.title: 루팅 · 아이템
categories.description: Build 42의 세분화된 전리품 배율과 재생성, 정리 정책을 설정합니다.

categories.title: 월드 · 자연
categories.description: 침식, 농사, 식량 부패, 자연 자원과 월드 이벤트를 설정합니다.

categories.title: 생존 · 캐릭터
categories.description: 부상, 체력, 제작, 독성, 읽기와 캐릭터 규칙을 설정합니다.

categories.title: 차량 · 연료
categories.description: 차량 생성, 상태, 연료, 충돌과 경보기를 설정합니다.

categories.title: 동물 · 사육
categories.description: Build 42 동물의 성장, 번식, 추적과 해충을 설정합니다.

categories.title: 전투 · 총기
categories.description: 근접 다중 타격, 총기 명중, 소음과 전투 보정을 설정합니다.

categories.title: 지도 · 건물
categories.description: 미니맵, 월드맵, 지하실과 랜덤 월드 스토리를 설정합니다.

categories.title: 좀비 특성
categories.description: 속도, 감각, 감염, 지능과 공격 행동을 세밀하게 설정합니다.

categories.title: 고급 좀비 개체수
categories.description: 최고 개체수, 재생성, 이동과 무리 형성을 설정합니다.

categories.title: 기술별 경험치
categories.description: 전역 또는 기술별 경험치 획득 배율을 설정합니다.

fields.name: zombies
fields.label: 좀비 개체수
fields.help: Changing this also sets the "Population Multiplier" in Advanced Zombie Options.

fields.name: distribution
fields.label: 좀비 분포
fields.help: How zombies are distributed across the map.

fields.name: zombie_voronoi_noise
fields.label: 분포 무작위화
fields.help: Controls whether some randomization is applied to zombie distribution.

fields.name: zombie_respawn
fields.label: 좀비 재생성 빈도
fields.help: How frequently new zombies are added to the world.

fields.name: zombie_migrate
fields.label: 빈 지역으로 이동
fields.help: Zombie allowed to migrate to empty cells.

fields.name: start_month
fields.label: 시작 월
fields.help: Month in which the game starts.

fields.name: start_day
fields.label: 시작 일
fields.help: Day of the month in which the games starts.

fields.name: start_time
fields.label: 시작 시간
fields.help: Hour of the day in which the game starts.

fields.name: day_night_cycle
fields.label: 낮·밤 주기
fields.help: Whether the time of day changes naturally, or it's always day/night.

fields.name: climate_cycle
fields.label: 날씨 주기
fields.help: Whether weather changes or remains at a single state.

fields.name: fog_cycle
fields.label: 안개 주기
fields.help: Whether fog occurs naturally, never occurs, or is always present.

fields.name: water_shut
fields.label: 수도 중단 시점
fields.help: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that plumbing fixtures (eg. sinks) stop being infinite sources of water.

fields.name: elec_shut
fields.label: 전기 중단 시점
fields.help: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that the world's electricity turns off for good.

fields.name: alarm_decay
fields.label: 경보기 배터리 수명
fields.help: How long alarm batteries can last for after the power shuts off.

fields.name: water_shut_modifier
fields.label: 수도 중단 일수
fields.help: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that plumbing fixtures (eg. sinks) stop being infinite sources of water.

fields.name: elec_shut_modifier
fields.label: 전기 중단 일수
fields.help: How long after the default start date (July 9, 1993) that the world's electricity turns off for good.

fields.name: alarm_decay_modifier
fields.label: 경보기 배터리 일수
fields.help: How long alarm batteries can last for after the power shuts off.

fields.name: food_loot
fields.label: 신선 식품
fields.help: Any food that can rot or spoil.

fields.name: literature_loot_new
fields.label: 일반 서적
fields.help: All other items that can be read, including books, fliers, and newspapers.

fields.name: skill_book_loot
fields.label: 기술 서적
fields.help: Books that provide skill XP multipliers.

fields.name: recipe_resource_loot
fields.label: 레시피 자료
fields.help: Items that teach recipes.

fields.name: medical_loot_new
fields.label: 의료품
fields.help: Medicine, bandages and first aid tools.

fields.name: survival_gears_loot_new
fields.label: 생존 장비
fields.help: Fishing Rods, Tents, camping gear etc.

fields.name: canned_food_loot_new
fields.label: 보존 식품
fields.help: Canned and dried food, beverages.

fields.name: weapon_loot
fields.label: 근접 무기
fields.help: Weapons that are not tools in other categories.

fields.name: ranged_weapon_loot_new
fields.label: 원거리 무기
fields.help: Also includes weapon attachments.

fields.name: ammo_loot_new
fields.label: 탄약
fields.help: Loose ammo, boxes and magazines.

fields.name: mechanics_loot_new
fields.label: 차량 정비품
fields.help: Vehicle parts and the tools needed to install them.

fields.name: other_loot
fields.label: 기타 전리품
fields.help: Everything else. Also affects foraging for all items in Town/Road zones.

fields.name: clothing_loot_new
fields.label: 의류
fields.help: All wearable items that are not containers.

fields.name: container_loot_new
fields.label: 가방·용기
fields.help: Backpacks and other wearable/equippable containers, eg. cases.

fields.name: key_loot_new
fields.label: 열쇠·자물쇠
fields.help: Keys for buildings/cars, key rings, and locks.

fields.name: media_loot_new
fields.label: 비디오·음반
fields.help: VHS tapes and CDs.

fields.name: memento_loot_new
fields.label: 수집품
fields.help: Spiffo items, plushies, and other collectible keepsake items eg. Photos.

fields.name: cookware_loot_new
fields.label: 조리 도구
fields.help: Items that are used in cooking, including those (eg. knives) which can be weapons. Does not include food. Includes both usable and unusable items.

fields.name: material_loot_new
fields.label: 제작 재료
fields.help: Items and weapons that are used as ingredients for crafting or building. This is a general category that does not include items belonging to other categories such as Cookware or Medical. Does not include Tools.

fields.name: farming_loot_new
fields.label: 농업 용품
fields.help: Items and weapons which are used in both animal and plant agriculture, such as Seeds, Trowels, or Shovels.

fields.name: tool_loot_new
fields.label: 일반 공구
fields.help: Items and weapons which are Tools but don't fit in other categories such as Mechanics or Farming.

fields.name: rolls_multiplier
fields.label: 루팅 횟수 배율
fields.help: <BHC> [!] It is recommended that you DO NOT change this. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>   Can be used to adjust the number of rolls made on loot tables when spawning loot. Will not reduce the number of rolls below 1. Can negatively affect performance if set to high values. It is highly recommended that this not be changed.

fields.name: loot_item_removal_list
fields.label: 루팅 제외 아이템
fields.help: A comma-separated list of item types that won't spawn as ordinary loot.

fields.name: remove_story_loot
fields.label: 스토리 전리품 제거
fields.help: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn in randomised world stories.

fields.name: remove_zombie_loot
fields.label: 좀비 전리품 제거
fields.help: If enabled, items on the Loot Item Removal List, or that have their rarity set to 'None', will not spawn worn by, or attached to, zombies.

fields.name: zombie_pop_loot_effect
fields.label: 좀비 수에 따른 루팅 보정
fields.help: If greater than 0, the spawn of loot is increased relative to the number of nearby zombies,  with the effect multiplied by this number.

fields.name: temperature
fields.label: 기온
fields.help: The global temperature.

fields.name: rain
fields.label: 강우량
fields.help: How often it rains.

fields.name: erosion_speed
fields.label: 침식 속도
fields.help: Number of days until the erosion system (which adds vines, long grass, new trees etc. to the world) will reach 100% growth.

fields.name: erosion_days
fields.label: 침식 완료 일수
fields.help: For a custom Erosion Speed. Zero means use the Erosion Speed option. Maximum is 36,500 days (approximately 100 years).

fields.name: farming_speed
fields.label: 작물 성장 속도
fields.help: The speed of plant growth.

fields.name: compost_time
fields.label: 퇴비 생성 시간
fields.help: How long it takes for food to break down in a composter.

fields.name: stats_decrease
fields.label: 허기·갈증 감소 속도
fields.help: How fast the player's hunger, thirst, and fatigue will decrease.

fields.name: nature_abundance
fields.label: 자연 자원
fields.help: The abundance of items found in Foraging mode.

fields.name: alarm_frequency
fields.label: 주택 경보기 빈도
fields.help: How likely the player is to activate a house alarm when breaking into a new house.

fields.name: locked_houses
fields.label: 잠긴 건물 빈도
fields.help: How frequently the doors of homes and buildings will be locked when discovered.

fields.name: starter_kit
fields.label: 시작 키트
fields.help: Spawn with Chips, a Water Bottle, a Small Backpack, a Baseball Bat, and a Hammer.

fields.name: nutrition
fields.label: 영양 시스템
fields.help: Nutritional value of food affects the player's condition. Turning this off will stop the player gaining or losing weight.

fields.name: food_rot_speed
fields.label: 식품 부패 속도
fields.help: How fast that food will spoil, inside or outside of a fridge.

fields.name: fridge_factor
fields.label: 냉장고 효율
fields.help: How effective a fridge will be at keeping food fresh for longer.

fields.name: seen_hours_prevent_loot_respawn
fields.label: 최근 방문 지역 루팅 제한 시간
fields.help: When greater than 0, loot will not respawn in zones that have been visited within this number of in-game hours.

fields.name: hours_for_loot_respawn
fields.label: 전리품 재생성 시간
fields.help: When greater than 0, after X hours, all containers in towns and trailer parks in the world will respawn loot. To spawn loot a container must have been looted at least once. Loot respawn is not impacted by visibility or subsequent looting.

fields.name: max_items_for_loot_respawn
fields.label: 재생성 제한 아이템 수
fields.help: Containers with a number of items greater, or equal to, this setting will not respawn.

fields.name: construction_prevents_loot_respawn
fields.label: 건축물이 루팅 재생성 방지
fields.help: Items will not respawn in buildings that players have barricaded or built in.

fields.name: world_item_removal_list
fields.label: 월드 아이템 정리 목록
fields.default: Base.Hat, Base.Glasses, Base.Maggots, Base.Slug, Base.Slug2, Base.Snail, Base.Worm, Base.Dung_Mouse, Base.Dung_Rat
fields.help: A comma-separated list of item types that will be removed after HoursForWorldItemRemoval hours.

fields.name: hours_for_world_item_removal
fields.label: 바닥 아이템 정리 시간
fields.help: Number of hours since an item was dropped on the ground before it is removed.  Items are removed the next time that part of the map is loaded.   Zero means items are not removed.

fields.name: item_removal_list_blacklist_toggle
fields.label: 정리 목록 반전
fields.help: If true, any items *not* in WorldItemRemovalList will be removed.

fields.name: time_since_apo
fields.label: 종말 이후 경과 개월
fields.help: How long after the end of the world to begin. This will affect starting world erosion and food spoilage. Does not affect the starting date.

fields.name: plant_resilience
fields.label: 작물 생명력
fields.help: How much water plants will lose per day, and their ability to avoid disease.

fields.name: plant_abundance
fields.label: 작물 수확량
fields.help: The yield of plants when harvested.

fields.name: end_regen
fields.label: 피로 회복 속도
fields.help: Recovery from being tired after performing actions.

fields.name: helicopter
fields.label: 헬리콥터 이벤트
fields.help: How regularly a helicopter passes over the Event Zone.

fields.name: meta_event
fields.label: 메타 이벤트
fields.help: How often zombie-attracting metagame events like distant gunshots will occur.

fields.name: sleeping_event
fields.label: 수면 이벤트
fields.help: How often events during the player's sleep, like nightmares, occur.

fields.name: generator_fuel_consumption
fields.label: 발전기 연료 소비
fields.help: How much fuel is consumed by generators per in-game hour.

fields.name: generator_spawning
fields.label: 발전기 생성 빈도
fields.help: The chance of electrical generators spawning on the map.

fields.name: annotated_map_chance
fields.label: 주석 지도 빈도
fields.help: How often a looted map will have notes on it, written by a deceased survivor.

fields.name: character_free_points
fields.label: 캐릭터 추가 포인트
fields.help: Adds free points during character creation.

fields.name: construction_bonus_points
fields.label: 건축물 내구도
fields.help: Gives player-built constructions extra hit points so they are  more resistant to zombie damage.

fields.name: night_darkness
fields.label: 밤 밝기
fields.help: The level of ambient lighting at night.

fields.name: night_length
fields.label: 밤 길이
fields.help: The time from dusk to dawn.

fields.name: bone_fracture
fields.label: 골절 허용
fields.help: If survivors can get broken limbs from impacts, zombie damage, falls etc.

fields.name: injury_severity
fields.label: 부상 심각도
fields.help: The impact that injuries have on your body, and their healing time.

fields.name: hours_for_corpse_removal
fields.label: 시체 제거 시간
fields.help: How long, in hours, before dead zombie bodies disappear from the world.  If 0, maggots will not spawn on corpses.

fields.name: decaying_corpse_health_impact
fields.label: 부패 시체 영향
fields.help: The impact that nearby decaying bodies has on the player's health and emotions.

fields.name: zombie_health_impact
fields.label: 살아있는 좀비의 건강 영향
fields.help: Whether nearby "living" zombies have the same impact on the player's health and emotions.

fields.name: blood_level
fields.label: 혈흔 양
fields.help: How much blood is sprayed on floors and walls by injuries.

fields.name: clothing_degradation
fields.label: 의류 마모 속도
fields.help: How quickly clothing degrades, becomes dirty, and bloodied.

fields.name: fire_spread
fields.label: 화재 확산
fields.help: If fires spread when started.

fields.name: days_for_rotten_food_removal
fields.label: 썩은 음식 제거 일수
fields.help: Number of in-game days before rotten food is removed from the map.  -1 means rotten food is never removed.

fields.name: allow_exterior_generator
fields.label: 실외 발전기 허용
fields.help: If enabled, generators will work on exterior tiles.  This will allow, for example, the powering of gas pumps.

fields.name: max_fog_intensity
fields.label: 최대 안개 강도
fields.help: Maximum intensity of fog.

fields.name: max_rain_fx_intensity
fields.label: 최대 비 효과
fields.help: Maximum intensity of rain.

fields.name: enable_snow_on_ground
fields.label: 지면 적설
fields.help: If snow will accumulate on the ground.  If disabled, snow will still show on vegetation and rooftops.

fields.name: attack_block_movements
fields.label: 공격 중 이동 제한
fields.help: If melee attacking slows you down.

fields.name: survivor_house_chance
fields.label: 생존자 주택 빈도
fields.help: The chance of finding randomized buildings on the map (eg. burnt out houses,  ones containing loot stashes or dead bodies).

fields.name: vehicle_story_chance
fields.label: 도로 차량 스토리
fields.help: The chance of road stories (eg. police roadblocks) spawning.

fields.name: zone_story_chance
fields.label: 지역 스토리
fields.help: The chance of stories specific to map zones (eg. a campsite in a forest) spawning.

fields.name: all_clothes_unlocked
fields.label: 모든 의류 해제
fields.help: Allows you to select from every piece of clothing in the game when customizing your character

fields.name: enable_tainted_water_text
fields.label: 오염된 물 경고
fields.help: If tainted water will show a warning marking it as such.

fields.name: enable_vehicles
fields.label: 차량 활성화
fields.help: If vehicles will spawn.

fields.name: car_spawn_rate
fields.label: 차량 생성 빈도
fields.help: How frequently vehicles can be discovered on the map.

fields.name: zombie_attraction_multiplier
fields.label: 차량 소음 유인 배율
fields.help: General engine loudness to zombies.

fields.name: vehicle_easy_use
fields.label: 차량 간편 사용
fields.help: Whether found vehicles are locked, need keys to start etc.

fields.name: initial_gas
fields.label: 초기 차량 연료
fields.help: How full the gas tank of discovered vehicles will be.

fields.name: fuel_station_gas_infinite
fields.label: 주유소 무한 연료
fields.help: If enabled, gas pumps will never run out of fuel

fields.name: fuel_station_gas_min
fields.label: 주유소 최소 연료
fields.help: The minimum amount of gasoline that can spawn in gas pumps. Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom amount.

fields.name: fuel_station_gas_max
fields.label: 주유소 최대 연료
fields.help: The maximum amount of gasoline that can spawn in gas pumps. Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom amount.

fields.name: fuel_station_gas_empty_chance
fields.label: 빈 주유기 확률
fields.help: The chance, as a percentage, that individual gas pumps will initially have no fuel.

fields.name: locked_car
fields.label: 잠긴 차량 빈도
fields.help: How likely cars will be locked

fields.name: car_gas_consumption
fields.label: 차량 연료 소비
fields.help: How gas-hungry vehicles are.

fields.name: car_general_condition
fields.label: 차량 전체 상태
fields.help: General condition discovered vehicles will be in.

fields.name: car_damage_on_impact
fields.label: 충돌 시 차량 피해
fields.help: The amount of damage dealt to vehicles that crash.

fields.name: damage_to_player_from_hit_by_a_car
fields.label: 차량 충돌 플레이어 피해
fields.help: Damage received by the player from being crashed into.

fields.name: traffic_jam
fields.label: 교통 체증 잔해
fields.help: If traffic jams consisting of wrecked cars  will appear on main roads.

fields.name: car_alarm
fields.label: 차량 경보기 빈도
fields.help: How frequently discovered vehicles have active alarms.

fields.name: player_damage_from_crash
fields.label: 사고 시 탑승자 피해
fields.help: If the player can get injured from being in a car accident.

fields.name: siren_shutoff_hours
fields.label: 사이렌 종료 시간
fields.help: How many in-game hours before a wailing siren shuts off.

fields.name: chance_has_gas
fields.label: 차량 연료 보유 확률
fields.help: The chance of finding a vehicle with gas in its tank.

fields.name: recently_survivor_vehicles
fields.label: 관리된 차량 빈도
fields.help: Whether a player can discover a car that has been cared for  after the Knox infection struck.

fields.name: multi_hit
fields.label: 다중 타격
fields.help: If certain melee weapons will be able to strike multiple zombies in one hit.

fields.name: rear_vulnerability
fields.label: 후방 취약도
fields.help: Chance of being bitten when a zombie attacks from behind.

fields.name: siren_effects_zombies
fields.label: 사이렌 좀비 유인
fields.help: If zombies will head towards the sound of vehicle sirens.

fields.name: animal_stats_modifier
fields.label: 동물 욕구 감소 속도
fields.help: Speed at which animals stats (hunger, thirst etc.) reduce.

fields.name: animal_meta_stats_modifier
fields.label: 비활성 동물 욕구 감소
fields.help: Speed at which animals stats (hunger, thirst etc.) reduce while in meta.

fields.name: animal_pregnancy_time
fields.label: 동물 임신 기간
fields.help: How long animals will be pregnant for before giving birth.

fields.name: animal_age_modifier
fields.label: 동물 성장 속도
fields.help: Speed at which animals age.

fields.name: animal_ranch_chance
fields.label: 농장 동물 생성 빈도
fields.help: The chance of finding animals in farm.

fields.name: animal_grass_regrow_time
fields.label: 목초 재성장 시간
fields.help: The number of hours grass will regrow after being  eaten by an animal or cut by the player.

fields.name: animal_meta_predator
fields.label: 야간 포식자
fields.help: If a meta (ie. not actually visible in-game) fox may attack  your chickens if the hutch's door is left open at night.

fields.name: animal_mating_season
fields.label: 번식기 적용
fields.help: If on, animals will only mate during their breeding season (if any).  Otherwise they can reproduce/lay eggs all year round.

fields.name: animal_egg_hatch
fields.label: 알 부화 속도
fields.help: How long before baby animals will hatch from eggs.

fields.name: animal_sound_attract_zombies
fields.label: 동물 소리 좀비 유인
fields.help: If true, animal calls will attract nearby zombies.

fields.name: animal_track_chance
fields.label: 동물 흔적 빈도
fields.help: The chance of animals leaving tracks.

fields.name: animal_path_chance
fields.label: 사냥 경로 빈도
fields.help: The chance of creating a path for animals to be hunted.

fields.name: maximum_rat_index
fields.label: 최대 해충 지수
fields.help: The frequency and intensity of eg. rats in infested buildings.

fields.name: days_until_maximum_rat_index
fields.label: 최대 해충 도달 일수
fields.help: How long it takes for the Maximum Vermin Index to be reached.

fields.name: meta_knowledge
fields.label: 미확인 미디어 표시
fields.help: If a piece of media hasn't been fully seen or read, this setting determines whether it's displayed fully, displayed as "???", or hidden completely.

fields.name: see_not_learnt_recipe
fields.label: 미학습 레시피 표시
fields.help: If true, you will be able to see any recipes that can be done with a station, even if you haven't learnt them yet.

fields.name: maximum_looted_building_rooms
fields.label: 루팅 건물 최대 방 수
fields.help: If a building has more than this amount of rooms it will not be looted.

fields.name: enable_poisoning
fields.label: 음식 독성 허용
fields.help: If poison can be added to food.

fields.name: maggot_spawn
fields.label: 구더기 생성
fields.help: If/when maggots can spawn in corpses.

fields.name: light_bulb_lifespan
fields.label: 전구 수명
fields.help: The higher the value, the longer lightbulbs last before breaking.  If 0, lightbulbs will never break.  Does not affect vehicle headlights.

fields.name: fish_abundance
fields.label: 어류 자원
fields.help: The abundance of fish in rivers and lakes.

fields.name: level_for_media_x_p_cutoff
fields.label: 미디어 경험치 제한 레벨
fields.help: When a skill is at this level or above, television/VHS/other media  will not provide XP for it.

fields.name: level_for_dismantle_x_p_cutoff
fields.label: 해체 경험치 제한 레벨
fields.help: When a skill is at this level or above, scrapping furniture does not provide XP for the relevant skill. Does not apply to Electrical.

fields.name: blood_splat_lifespan_days
fields.label: 혈흔 유지 일수
fields.help: Number of days before old blood splats are removed. Removal happens when map chunks are loaded. 0 means they will never disappear.

fields.name: literature_cooldown
fields.label: 서적 재사용 대기 일수
fields.help: Number of days before one can benefit from reading previously read literature items.

fields.name: negative_traits_penalty
fields.label: 부정 특성 점수 페널티

options.label: 1 point penalty for every 3 negative traits selected
1 point penalty for every 2 negative traits selected
1 point penalty for every negative trait selected after the first

fields.help: If there are diminishing returns on bonus trait points provided from selecting multiple negative traits.

fields.name: minutes_per_page
fields.label: 페이지당 읽기 시간
fields.help: The number of in-game minutes it takes to read one page of a skill book.

fields.name: kill_inside_crops
fields.label: 실내 작물 고사
fields.help: When enabled, crops and herbs grown inside buildings will die. Does not affect houseplants.

fields.name: plant_growing_seasons
fields.label: 계절별 작물 성장
fields.help: When enabled, the growth of plants is affected by seasons.

fields.name: place_dirt_aboveground
fields.label: 상층 흙 배치
fields.help: <BHC> [!] It is recommended that you DO NOT change this. Changing this can result in performance issues. [!] <RGB:1,1,1>   When enabled, dirt can be placed, and farming performed on other than the ground level.

fields.name: farming_speed_new
fields.label: 작물 성장 배율
fields.help: The speed of plant growth.

fields.name: farming_amount_new
fields.label: 작물 수확 배율
fields.help: The abundance of harvested crops.

fields.name: maximum_looted
fields.label: 이미 털린 건물 최대 확률
fields.help: The chance that any building will already be looted when found. Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom number.

fields.name: days_until_maximum_looted
fields.label: 최대 털림 확률 도달 일수
fields.help: How long it takes for Maximum Looted Building Chance to be reached.

fields.name: rural_looted
fields.label: 시골 건물 털림 배율
fields.help: The chance that any rural building will already be looted when found. Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom number.

fields.name: maximum_diminished_loot
fields.label: 최대 전리품 감소율
fields.help: The maximum loot that won't spawn when Days Until Maximum Diminished Loot is reached. Check the "Advanced" box below to use an exact percentage.

fields.name: days_until_maximum_diminished_loot
fields.label: 최대 감소 도달 일수
fields.help: How long it takes for Maximum Diminished Loot Percentage to be reached.

fields.name: muscle_strain_factor
fields.label: 근육 피로 배율
fields.help: Functions as a multiplier when applying muscle strain from swinging weapons or carrying heavy loads.

fields.name: discomfort_factor
fields.label: 착용 불편 배율
fields.help: Functions as a multiplier when applying discomfort from worn items.

fields.name: wound_infection_factor
fields.label: 상처 감염 피해 배율
fields.help: If greater than zero damage can be taken from serious wound infections.

fields.name: no_black_clothes
fields.label: 과도하게 어두운 의류 방지
fields.help: If true clothing with randomized tints will not be so dark to be virtually black.

fields.name: easy_climbing
fields.label: 등반 실패 비활성화
fields.help: Disables the failure chances when climbing sheet ropes or over walls.

fields.name: maximum_fire_fuel_hours
fields.label: 최대 화로 연료 시간
fields.help: The maximum hours of fuel that can be placed in a campfire, wood stove etc.

fields.name: firearm_use_damage_chance
fields.label: 총기 피해 판정 방식
fields.help: Replaces Chance-To-Hit mechanics with Chance-To-Damage calculations.  This mode prioritizes player aiming.

fields.name: firearm_noise_multiplier
fields.label: 총기 소음 배율
fields.help: A multiplier for the distance at which zombies can hear gunshots.

fields.name: firearm_jam_multiplier
fields.label: 총기 걸림 배율
fields.help: Multiplier for firearm jamming chance. 0 disables jamming.

fields.name: firearm_moodle_multiplier
fields.label: 기분 상태 명중 보정
fields.help: Multiplier for Moodle effects on hit chance. 0 disables Moodle penalty.

fields.name: firearm_weather_multiplier
fields.label: 날씨 명중 보정
fields.help: Multiplier for the effects of weather (wind, rain and fog) on hit chance. 0 disables weather effect.

fields.name: firearm_head_gear_effect
fields.label: 머리 장비 명중 영향
fields.help: Enable to have headgear like welding masks affect hit chance

fields.name: clay_lake_chance
fields.label: 호수 점토 확률
fields.help: Chance to turn a dirt floor into a clay floor. Applies to lakes.

fields.name: clay_river_chance
fields.label: 강 점토 확률
fields.help: Chance to turn a dirt floor into a clay floor. Applies to rivers.

fields.name: generator_vertical_power_range
fields.label: 발전기 수직 범위
fields.help: How many levels both above and below a generator it can provide with electricity.

fields.name: basement__spawn_frequency
fields.label: 지하실 생성 빈도
fields.help: How frequently basements spawn at random locations.

fields.name: map__allow_mini_map
fields.label: 미니맵 허용
fields.help: If enabled, a mini-map window will be available.

fields.name: map__allow_world_map
fields.label: 월드맵 허용
fields.help: If enabled, the world map can be accessed.

fields.name: map__map_all_known
fields.label: 전체 지도 공개
fields.help: If enabled, the world map will be completely filled in on starting the game.

fields.name: map__map_needs_light
fields.label: 지도 열람 시 빛 필요
fields.help: If enabled, maps can't be read unless there's a source of light available.

fields.name: zombie_lore__speed
fields.label: 좀비 이동 속도
fields.help: How fast zombies move.

fields.name: zombie_lore__sprinter_percentage
fields.label: 질주 좀비 비율
fields.help: If Random Speed is enabled, this controls what percentage of zombies are Sprinters. Check the "Advanced" box below to use a custom percentage.

fields.name: zombie_lore__strength
fields.label: 좀비 공격력
fields.help: The damage zombies inflict per attack.

fields.name: zombie_lore__toughness
fields.label: 좀비 내구력
fields.help: The difficulty of killing a zombie.

fields.name: zombie_lore__transmission
fields.label: 감염 전파 방식
fields.help: How the Knox Virus spreads.

fields.name: zombie_lore__mortality
fields.label: 감염 발병 시간
fields.help: How quickly the infection takes effect.

fields.name: zombie_lore__reanimate
fields.label: 사망 후 부활 시간
fields.help: How quickly infected corpses rise as zombies.

fields.name: zombie_lore__cognition
fields.label: 좀비 지능
fields.help: Zombie intelligence.

fields.name: zombie_lore__crawl_under_vehicle
fields.label: 차량 아래 기어가기
fields.help: How often zombies can crawl under parked vehicles.

fields.name: zombie_lore__memory
fields.label: 좀비 기억력
fields.help: How long zombies remember a player after seeing or hearing them.

fields.name: zombie_lore__sight
fields.label: 좀비 시야
fields.help: Zombie vision radius.

fields.name: zombie_lore__hearing
fields.label: 좀비 청각
fields.help: Zombie hearing radius.

fields.name: zombie_lore__spotted_logic
fields.label: 고급 은신 판정
fields.help: Activates the new advanced stealth mechanics, which allows you to hide from zombies behind cars, takes traits and weather into account, and much more.

fields.name: zombie_lore__thump_no_chasing
fields.label: 추적 중이 아닐 때 구조물 공격
fields.help: If zombies that have not seen/heard player can attack doors and constructions while roaming.

fields.name: zombie_lore__thump_on_construction
fields.label: 플레이어 건축물 파괴
fields.help: If zombies can destroy player constructions and defenses.

fields.name: zombie_lore__active_only
fields.label: 활동 시간대
fields.help: Whether zombies are more "active" during the day or night.  "Active" zombies will use the speed set in the "Speed" setting.  "Inactive" zombies will be slower, and tend not to give chase.

fields.name: zombie_lore__trigger_house_alarm
fields.label: 좀비의 주택 경보기 작동
fields.help: If zombies trigger house alarms when breaking through windows or doors.

fields.name: drag_down
fields.label: 좀비 끌어내리기
fields.help: If multiple attacking zombies can drag you down and kill you.  Dependent on zombie strength.

fields.name: zombie_lore__zombies_crawlers_drag_down
fields.label: 기어다니는 좀비 끌어내리기 기여
fields.help: If crawler zombies beside a player contribute to the chance of being dragged down and killed by a group of zombies.

fields.name: fence_lunge
fields.label: 울타리 돌진
fields.help: If zombies have a chance to lunge at you after climbing over a fence or through a window if you're too close.

fields.name: zombie_lore__zombies_armor_factor
fields.label: 좀비 방어구 효과
fields.help: Serves as a multiplier when determining the effectiveness of armor worn by zombies.

fields.name: zombie_lore__zombies_max_defense
fields.label: 좀비 최대 방어율
fields.help: The maximum defense percentage that any worn protective garments can provide to a zombie.

fields.name: zombie_lore__chance_of_attached_weapon
fields.label: 부착 무기 확률
fields.help: Percentage chance of having a random attached weapon.

fields.name: zombie_lore__zombies_fall_damage
fields.label: 좀비 낙하 피해
fields.help: How much damage zombies take when falling from height.

fields.name: zombie_lore__disable_fake_dead
fields.label: 가짜 시체 부활
fields.help: Whether some dead-looking zombies will reanimate and attack the player.

fields.name: zombie_lore__player_spawn_zombie_removal
fields.label: 시작 위치 좀비 제거 범위

fields.help: Zombies will not spawn where players spawn.

fields.name: zombie_lore__fence_thumpers_required
fields.label: 높은 울타리 파괴 필요 좀비 수

fields.name: zombie_lore__fence_damage_multiplier

fields.help: How quickly zombies damage tall fences.

fields.name: zombie_config__population_multiplier
fields.label: 전체 개체수 배율
fields.help: Set by the "Zombie Count" population option, or by a custom number here. Insane = 2.5, Very High = 1.6, High = 1.2, Normal = 0.65, Low = 0.15, None = 0.0.

fields.name: zombie_config__population_start_multiplier
fields.label: 시작 개체수 배율
fields.help: A multiplier for the desired zombie population at the start of the game. Insane = 3.0, Very High = 2.0, High = 1.5, Normal = 1.0, Low = 0.5, None = 0.0.

fields.name: zombie_config__population_peak_multiplier
fields.label: 최고 개체수 배율
fields.help: A multiplier for the desired zombie population on the peak day. Insane = 3.0, Very High = 2.0, High = 1.5, Normal = 1.0, Low = 0.5, None = 0.0.

fields.name: zombie_config__population_peak_day
fields.label: 최고 개체수 도달 일
fields.help: The day when the population reaches its peak.

fields.name: respawn_hours
fields.label: 재생성 주기
fields.help: The number of hours that must pass before zombies may respawn in a cell. If 0, spawning is disabled.

fields.name: respawn_unseen_hours
fields.label: 미확인 지역 재생성 대기
fields.help: The number of hours that a chunk must be unseen before zombies may respawn in it.

fields.name: respawn_multiplier
fields.label: 회차당 재생성 비율
fields.help: The fraction of a cell's desired population that may respawn every RespawnHours.

fields.name: zombie_config__redistribute_hours
fields.label: 빈 지역 이동 주기
fields.help: The number of hours that must pass before zombies migrate  to empty parts of the same cell. If 0, migration is disabled.

fields.name: zombie_config__follow_sound_distance
fields.label: 소리 추적 거리
fields.help: The distance a zombie will try to walk towards the last sound it heard.

fields.name: zombie_config__rally_group_size
fields.label: 무리 크기
fields.help: The size of groups real zombies form when idle. 0 means zombies don't form groups. Groups don't form inside buildings or forest zones.

fields.name: zombie_config__rally_group_size_variance
fields.label: 무리 크기 변동률
fields.help: The amount, as a percentage, that zombie groups can vary in size from the default (both larger and smaller).   For example, at 50% variance with a default group size of 20, groups will vary in size from 10-30.

fields.name: zombie_config__rally_travel_distance
fields.label: 무리 합류 거리
fields.help: The distance real zombies travel to form groups when idle.

fields.name: zombie_config__rally_group_separation
fields.label: 무리 간 거리
fields.help: The distance between zombie groups.

fields.name: zombie_config__rally_group_radius
fields.label: 무리 반경
fields.help: How close members of a zombie group stay to the group's "leader".

fields.name: zombie_config__zombies_count_before_delete
fields.label: 정리 전 최대 추적 좀비 수
fields.help: Controls the maximum number of zombies tracked before cleanup occurs. 0 means zombies will not be cleaned up. The default value (300) is strongly recommended. Increasing this value or setting to 0 may cause severe performance problems. For troubleshooting and bug-report purposes, please reproduce any issue with the default setting before submitting a report.
